note: Source identity registry used by schema/semantic_validate.py in generated mode. Only the brand itself, its domains and generic store/rating/endpoint patterns are kept as plain patterns; real people, organisations, customer domains, CTA labels and copy are stored as hashes in schema/source-identity-hashes.json so this repo never transcribes them.

sourceBrand.caseNote: 'Teachable' is matched case-sensitively so the ordinary lowercase adjective stays usable in generated copy.

rating.note: Pattern 1 is the source's review handle/date line format; 2-3 are review-score phrasings (policy extension: no numeric score appears in the clone).

cta.rule: a generated action label is rejected when it starts with one of these verbs and names the source brand/product, or when it equals a source CTA label of 3+ words (hashed).
